overview: The Medford School Committee approved a new pilot student exchange program with Italy, updated facilities department job descriptions, adjusted the district's vocational school expansion plan, and passed resolutions supporting the LGBTQIA+ community and diversity, equity, and inclusion.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The committee voted to enter executive session to discuss litigation strategy regarding CODIS versus Medford Public Schools.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: The committee approved the consent agenda, which included bills, payrolls, capital purchases, grants, field trips, and minutes from the February 10, 2025 meeting.

items.title: International Travel and Exchange Program
items.summary: The committee approved a pilot student exchange program with a school in Italy, scheduled for October 2025 and April 2026.

items.title: Facilities Director Job Description
items.summary: The committee approved an updated job description for the Facilities Director position, amended to clarify on-call availability and their role in special projects.

items.title: Assistant Facilities Director Job Description
items.summary: The committee approved a new job description for the Assistant Facilities Director, amended to clarify weather mitigation planning and collective bargaining support.

items.title: Chapter 74 CTE Expansion Plan Updates
items.summary: The committee approved removing veterinary science from the district's expansion submission and adjusting timelines for other career and technical education programs.

items.title: Policy IKF: Graduation and Competency Determination Requirements
items.summary: The committee approved the second reading of updated Policy IKF regarding high school graduation requirements in response to state ballot question two.

items.title: Policy ADFW: Water Wellness Policy
items.summary: The committee approved the second reading of Policy ADFW, amended to lower the acceptable lead threshold from 15 to 10 parts per billion.

items.title: Resolution in Support of the LGBTQIA+ Community
items.summary: The committee approved a resolution affirming support for the safety, privacy, and educational rights of LGBTQIA+ students and staff.

items.title: Resolution Reaffirming Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
items.summary: The committee approved a resolution reaffirming its commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, and opposing any efforts to restrict inclusive educational materials.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: The committee expressed condolences to the families of Bruno DeVito, Robert E. Skerry, and Ruth 'Cherry' Youngblood.
